# FTIEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FTI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FTI/FTIEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition`

Manual: [FTIEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FTIEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition.md)

```text
FTIEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition, version 0.01

Usage: FTIEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --ground-file : name of the file corresponding to the ground state of the whole system
    --degenerated-groundstate : single column file describing a degenerated ground state
    --min-na : minimum size of the particles whose entropy has to be evaluated (default value = 1)
    --max-na : maximum size of the particles whose entropy has to be evaluated (0 if equal to half the total system size) (default value = 0)
    --show-time : show time required for each operation
    -s, --nbr-subbands : number of subbands (default value = 1)
    --enhance : symmetry-enhanced unit cell with respect to file-name (for OFL with symmetry model)
    --decoupled : assume that the FTI states are made of two decoupled FCI copies
    --3d : consider a 3d model instead of a 2d model
    --Wannier : Wannier basis
    --allowed-orbitals : provide an ASCII file indicating which orbitals are allowed

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with partent extension
    --density-matrix : store the eigenvalues of the partial density matrices in the a given file
    --density-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix
    --kya-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix only for a subsystem with a fixed total Ky value (default value = 0)
    --nbr-eigenstates : number of reduced density matrix eigenstates to compute (0 if all) (default value = 0)

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
